widgets_values:
## Read left to right. Pose, match the expression, then ground the cutout

1. Ask Gemini to remove the person and keep the background. Load that in EMPTY BACKGROUND and the original in REFERENCE PHOTO.
2. SCENE FROM REFERENCE describes the place and lighting. EXPRESSION FROM REFERENCE describes only the expression and where the eyes look. BUILD PROMPT joins the character line, that expression, and the scene.
3. NEW CHARACTER is generated in the reference pose, in tight swim briefs, then stitched onto the empty background.
4. EXPRESSION PASS redraws only the new face (EXPRESSION MASK), using the reference photo as the guide for expression and eye direction. The character LoRA stays on, so it is still this man. APPLY EXPRESSION puts that face back.
5. MARRY PASS redraws only the contact ring. KEEP CHARACTER, KEEP FACE puts that ring back and leaves the face and the body interior untouched.

If the eyes are still wrong, raise the denoise on EXPRESSION PASS. If the face turns into the reference person, lower it. If the person still floats, raise the first number on CONTACT HALO. If the clothes change, lower the denoise on MARRY PASS.

nodes.title: SCENE FROM REFERENCE
widgets_values: A wide open ocean shoreline at golden hour, with a breaking wave rolling toward the camera and a distant tree-lined coastline along the horizon. The scene is viewed from a low, slightly elevated water-level camera angle, looking toward the shore, with the ocean surface occupying the foreground and middle ground. Warm late-afternoon sunlight comes from the upper left/front-left, producing soft golden illumination across the water, bright highlights on the wave foam, and a warm pink-orange sky. The sky contains thin scattered clouds with subtle pastel tones, transitioning from pale yellow near the horizon to pink and muted blue higher in the frame. The water is textured with natural ripples, reflections, translucent wave faces, and white foam. The central area of the image must remain an uninterrupted open background region, with clear unobstructed space and continuous water/wave texture extending naturally through it. Do not place any object, wave crest, foam, splash, spray, foreground element, debris, board, vegetation, or other structure in front of or across this central region. Nothing should overlap, cross, cover, or intrude into the central silhouette area. Reconstruct only the background surfaces that would naturally exist there, preserving the existing perspective, lighting direction, color, focus, texture scale, and photographic appearance.
